get_time.description: Returns the current local date and time.

visit_page_tool.description: Visits a specific URL and optionally extracts information based on a query.

manage_user_preferences.description: Updates the user profile and preferences store.

replace_fs_text.description: Finds and replaces text in a file.

replace_fs_lines.description: Overwrites a line range in a file.

read_fs_file.description: Reads content from a persistent file.

request_clarification.description: Asks the user for clarification when the prompt is ambiguous or needs more details. Suspends execution until the user responds.

research.description: Autonomous deep research agent for complex investigations.

ls_files.description: Returns a list of files and directories in a given path.

patch_file_system.description: Updates file metadata or content by ID.

document_agent.description: Analyzes an uploaded document using RAG or vision.

document_agent_rag.description: Performs a semantic search (RAG) across the chunks of the uploaded document.

grep_uploaded_file.description: Performs a literal text or regex search across the raw extracted text of the uploaded file.

read_uploaded_file.description: Reads a specific range of lines or a specific page from the raw text of the uploaded file.

manage_task_list.description: Creates, updates, or views a persistent task list/checklist.

browsing_agent.description: Autonomous browsing agent for complex web interaction tasks.

browser_navigate.description: Navigates the browser to a specific URL.

browser_read_page.description: Extracts visible text content from the current page.

browser_click.description: Clicks an element by CSS selector.

browser_scroll.description: Scrolls the page up or down.

browser_get_interactive_elements.description: Returns a structured list of clickable/typeable elements.

browser_back.description: Navigates back to the previous page in the browser history.

browser_screenshot.description: Takes a full-page screenshot of the current page.
